product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Studio Workstation with Dual 3U Rack Bays and 61-key Keyboard Controller Tray
product.description: Stage Right™STUDIO WORKSTATIONPremium workstation for the modern home studio at a fraction of the costStudio organization is critical when building out a home or project studio and no piece of gear is more important than a proper studio desk. Unfortunately, studio desks are expensive, often costing much more than a high‑end studio mic or piece of outboard gear, and a desk won't necessarily improve your sound! The Stage Right™ Studio Workstation exists to provide a professional, yet affordable solution for home and project studios. Save for your next piece of high‑quality recording gear without compromising on a professional studio desk with the Stage Right Studio Workstation.Sliding keyboard shelf fits up to 61‑key MIDI controllersTwo 3U rack bays for outboard gearRaised shelf for displays and studio monitors1" thick, commercial‑grade boards and constructionPremium build qualityCompact footprint DESIGNED FOR THE MODERN STUDIOThe Stage Right™ Studio Workstation isn't just exceptional for its build quality and price. It succeeds in functionality, meeting the needs of modern home studio owners. With its 42" sliding keyboard shelf, the Stage Right Studio Workstation can accommodate all popular MIDI keyboard controllers, up of 61 keys. Additionally, it features two 3U rack compartments for 19" gear, such as outboard preamps, interfaces, and dynamics. Each rack compartment sits underneath a 44" wide platform for both your computer and studio monitors. PREMIUM BUILD QUALITYUnlike other inexpensive desk options, the Stage Right™ Studio Workstation does not compromise on build or materials. It is constructed from 1" thick, commercial‑grade Melamine Faced Chipboard (MFC), which is a superior material to Medium Density Fiberboard (MDF), when used in furniture construction. Its superior materials and solid legs make it as sturdy and durable as any other piece of high‑end office furniture, while providing additional stability for the top and keyboard shelf.COMPACT FOOTPRINTUnlike in the past, modern home and project studios get built around minimal pieces of gear. The Stage Right™ Studio Workstation wastes no additional studio space while providing ample features to accommodate all of your gear. Measuring 47" across and 27.5" deep, the Stage Right Studio Workstation will take up as much space as a traditional, medium‑sized home office desk, while leaving no need unaddressed.1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well! If the product you purchase does not satisfy your needs, send it back for a full refund.30 Day Money Back GuaranteeMonoprice™ stands behind every product we sell with a 30 day money back guarantee! If the product you purchase does not satisfy your needs, send it back for a full refund.Quality at a Fair PriceMonoprice's rugged design and rigid quality control standards deliver high quality products at fair prices.Hassle Free PackagingMonoprice exists to bring simplicity, fairness, and confidence to technology choices. This product features recyclable packaging that is simple to open, cost effective, with minimal waste, and fully protective as it travels to you.Service and SupportYou're never on your own with Monoprice products! We have a full team of friendly and knowledgeable technicians available to answer your questions, both before and after the sale. Contact our technical support team for questions about our products, troubleshooting, or even suggestions for products to fit your particular needs. Not to be outdone, our friendly and helpful customer service team is here to make your ordering, delivery, and any possible returns a quick and painless operation, from start to finish! Support Files: User's Manual (Jul 7, 2021)Monoprice™, Stage Right™, the Stage Right logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
